guess.headerNotValues: the header says {header}, but the values look like {values}
guess.unknown: neither its header nor its values identify it
guess.otherKind: {field} is not part of {kind, select, flights {flights} other {sightings}}
mapping.twice: Columns {columns} both hold the {field}. Choose one.
mapping.noFlight: No column holds the flight number, or the from and to airports.
row.unknownPhase: Status "{status}" is not a known phase, so it is stored as "other".
row.operatorName: "{name}" is a name, not an airline code, so it is added as an operator.
row.country: The sheet says the registration country is {country}, but {registration} has the {prefix} prefix.
row.distance: The sheet says {km} km, but the great-circle distance is {greatCircle} km. The great-circle distance is used.
times.landing: Takeoff {takeoff} plus duration {duration} lands at {landed} ({offset}), but the row says {landing}. Landing {landing} minus the duration gives takeoff {implied}.
times.landingTwelve: Takeoff {takeoff} plus duration {duration} lands at {landed} ({offset}), but the row says {landing}. Landing {landing} minus the duration gives takeoff {implied}, so {takeoff} looks like a 12-hour clock slip.
times.unknownAirport: {count, plural, one {One time is} other {# times are}} left out because Touchdown does not know {codes}. Add {airports, plural, one {it as an airport} other {them as airports}}, then read the file again.
times.noAirport: {count, plural, one {One time is} other {# times are}} left out because the row gives no {side, select, from {departure} other {arrival}} airport.
match.afterMidnight: The flight left after midnight: boarding was at {clock} the evening before.
inbox.otherVersion: an inbox file from another version of Touchdown
inbox.noLists: malformed: no list of sightings or flights
inbox.sheetAlone: a file with a spreadsheet holds nothing else
inbox.size: no records or changes, or more than {max} records
inbox.flightEmpty: flight {n} has no flight number, route or registration
inbox.openNotes: malformed notes on the open fields
sheet.noColumns: no columns given, and it is not the Flightradar24 export
sheet.notEnough: its columns do not hold enough to read rows
changes.notList: malformed: changes is not a list
changes.name: malformed name
points.count: points is a list of 2 to {max} points
points.order: points are not in time order
view.dataset: a view counts flights or sightings
view.sameDimension: the rows and the columns need two different dimensions
view.flightsOnly: distance and time are measured for flights only
edit.unknownFields: {fields} {count, plural, one {is not a field} other {are not fields}} that can be changed. Fields: {allowed}.
edit.notFlight: The values given could not be read as a flight.
edit.landingNote: The flight has no takeoff or scheduled departure, so the landing at {clock} is the first after the start of {date} at {airport}.
edit.notTime: {field} "{value}" could not be read as a time on {date}.
edit.notTimeNoDate: {field} "{value}" could not be read as a time on the flight's date.
edit.scheduledNeeds: The scheduled times need the flight's date and both airports.
edit.arrivalNotTime: arrivalScheduled "{value}" could not be read as a time after the departure at {departure}.
edit.arrivalNoDeparture: arrivalScheduled "{value}" could not be read as a time: give departureScheduled too.
edit.operatedBy: operatedBy "{value}" is not an airline code or name that is known.
edit.time: time "{value}" needs the sighting's date and a known airport, or a full date-time with its offset.
edit.phase: phase is one of {values}, or several with commas, not "{value}".
edit.tags: tags are words such as night or partial_body, not "{value}".
status.gone: It is no longer in the log.
status.same: The log has these values already.
status.editChanged: It was changed after this edit was made.
status.deleteChanged: It was changed after this deletion was asked for.
status.aircraftGone: The aircraft is no longer in the log.
status.aircraftSame: The aircraft has these values already.
status.aircraftChanged: The aircraft was changed after this edit was made.
status.merged: The aircraft was merged or removed already.
status.mergeIntoGone: The aircraft to merge into is no longer in the log.
status.findingGone: That finding no longer applies: the values it was about have changed.
status.noFix: That finding has no such fix now.
status.noImport: There is no such import in the log.
status.family: The type is counted that way already.
status.factsMismatch: These facts no longer fit your records: {reason}.
status.factsSame: The aircraft has these facts already, or your own values, which are kept.
status.flightGone: The flight is no longer in the log.
status.trackSame: The flight has this track already.
status.noTrack: The flight has no recorded track.
apply.undoLeft: {count, plural, one {{count} record changed after that import was left as it is} other {{count} records changed after that import were left as they are}}, and the import stays to undo.
apply.merged: It has the serial number of another aircraft in your log, so the two were merged.
